regulations.name: IEC 60601-1-11:2015 + A1:2020 / EN 60601-1-11:2015 + A1:2021
regulations.description: Requirements for ME equipment intended for use in home healthcare environments

tests.requirement: Instructions for use for ME equipment intended for use by a lay operator include easily understood diagrams, illustrations, or photographs of the fully assembled and ready-to-operate ME equipment including all controls, visual information signals, and indicators provided
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'SETUP AND OPERATING PROCEDURES' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Additional requirements for ME equipment start-up procedure

sub_tests.requirement: Easily understood diagrams, illustrations, or photographs showing proper connection of the patient to the ME equipment, accessories and other equipment
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'SETUP AND OPERATING PROCEDURES' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: The time from switching 'on' until the ME equipment is ready for normal use, when it exceeds 15 s (see 15.4.4 of Part 1)
The time required for ME equipment to warm from the minimum storage temperature between uses until it is ready for intended use
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MAINTENANCE' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: The time required for ME equipment to cool from the maximum storage temperature between uses until it is ready for intended use
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MAINTENANCE' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Instructions for use for ME equipment intended for use by a lay operator include a description of generally known conditions in the home healthcare environment that can unacceptably affect the basic safety and essential performance of the ME equipment

sub_tests.requirement: The steps that can be taken by the lay operator to identify and resolve the above conditions
At least the following issues are also included as applicable
The effects of lint, dust, light (including sunlight), etc.
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MAINTENANCE' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: A list of known devices or other sources that can potentially cause interference problems
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'NOTICE' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: The effects of degraded sensors and electrodes, or loosened electrodes, that can degrade performance or cause other problems
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MAINTENANCE' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: The effects caused by pets, pests or children
sub_tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'NOTICE' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: The instructions for use explain the meaning of the IP classification marked on the ME equipment, and on any carrying case provided with the ME equipment as applicable

tests.requirement: Instructions for use include a troubleshooting guide for use when there are indications of a ME equipment malfunction during start-up or operation
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'TROUBLESHOOTING' of operation guide

sub_tests.requirement: Troubleshooting guide discloses the necessary steps in the event of a technical alarm condition

semantic_fragments.content: 根据IEC 60601-1-11:2015+A1:2020标准第7.4.3至7.4.6条款，针对家庭护理环境中供非专业操作者使用的ME设备，操作指南须包含：完整组装和可操作设备的易懂图示（含所有控件和指示器）；患者连接示意图；启动及预热/冷却时间说明；环境条件影响（灰尘、光线、干扰源、传感器退化、宠物/儿童等）描述及应对步骤；以及故障排除指南（含技术报警条件处理步骤）。所有条款均通过（P），设备超过15秒启动时间条款及IP分类说明条款标注为不适用（N/A）。
